facts.fact: 日记日期：2024 年 10 月 14 日，大雾天，电塔顶部被雾遮住
雾浓到遮住电塔顶，山谷变成一口白锅，道路、风机、羊群全部消失
facts.anchor: Fog so thick this afternoon that it hid the top of the pylon

facts.fact: 他过去出门总是绕开电塔，这次却主动走近它——至少距屋百码，脚下是石楠与苔草
facts.anchor: He’d always walked away from the thing on his ventures out of the house. This time, he chose to approach it

facts.fact: 电塔第二座土丘上躺着一只崭新荧光绿网球，令人憎恶地眼熟，他脚下如灌混凝土无法动弹
facts.anchor: There was a bright green tennis ball lying on the second mound. A bright green, brand-new tennis ball, hatefully familiar

facts.fact: 电线里传出 Caroline 的声音命令他快跑，他朝小屋跑时踩空扭伤脚踝，手掌被割出血
facts.anchor: Run, said Caroline’s voice from the wires. Run away as fast as you c—

facts.fact: Caroline 的声音第二次命令他跑并喊出 Arthur 的名字——他正想指出「你叫我 Arthur」时电塔臂臂垂下
facts.anchor: Run, said Caroline again from a hedge of static. Arthur, run!

facts.fact: 他跌倒处地面嵌着半只咖啡杯残片，杯上「World’s Best D—」字样——他怀疑 Arthur 把碎杯埋在荒原作召唤仪式
facts.anchor: the broken half of a coffee mug – brown, and with the words World’s Best D— just visible above the turf

facts.fact: 他把球用力掷进浓雾，球沿原轨迹飞回打在他脸上，他本能拍开，受伤的手掌剧痛如遭雷击
facts.anchor: Then the ball came flying back on the same trajectory

facts.fact: 雾中走出一个苍白如空气的身影，狐狸般的步态，穿派克大衣的女孩，笑脸如石膏天使——他连念三遍「荒原上有徒步者」后在门口昏倒
facts.anchor: a figure came out of the mist, pale as air, and indistinct as a figure from a dream. It started to move towards him with a lilting, dancing gait, like a fox in the skin of a girl. A girl in a parka, with a smile like a plaster angel
